reviews.title: 👎🏾they randomly disappeared?🤨
reviews.text:
0.2 star 
I believe Someone already said this
But i didn’t think it would happen to me as well- then 3 other of my friends confirmed it; that it happened to them as well…The Stickers just disappeared. This junk was working JUST! Fine the other day - and now all the sudden the sticker packs from my iMessage text bar just vanished(😒). We now know the problem is from the developers’ end🙄 and not our iPhones. So now The app is there and working but it’s pretty much useless & basically taking up storage space Since it’s not working on iMessage. I Can see *them (*the developers) completely nullify this app…that’s how it usually starts. Back then, Top Stickers used to allow you to send mini gifs (they took that away) now they’ve taken away the ability for consumers to send stickers/emojis through iMessage…So as for me;
They get a 0.2 star. I would’ve said 0 star but something tells me it might be a bug so don’t count them out yet- but I know the disappointment is coming so ..(it is what it is🙄)
 👎🏾 pfft!
